description: BidiIsolation.ALWAYS with a template that mixes a file-defined (generated) placeholder with two caller-supplied ones. In interpolateTemplate only the immutableContext else-branch consults shouldApplyBidiIsolation (DefaultStrings.java:1365-1371); the placeholderBindings branch that expands generated values never does. So one resolved string carries isolated caller values and a bare generated value, which is the only shape that catches a port isolating every interpolated slot.
